title: Prove a strict ordinary K7 component above 0.0039 with a charged 25-bit installer
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the K7 ordinary source retained by [#8072](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8072), choose `η=1/256` and ordinary heights `(8192,106000,1681001)`. The three directed recurrences strictly book `q=0.003900000000000005`. With the first two heights fixed, `1681000` fails; the old `524288` cap and the original `η=0.0039` also fail. The exact admissible interval for these retained parameter/geometry gates and the fixed booking is `q<η<1/250`.

Separately, extend the fixed-installer serial model to two entry ordinary recipes, three terminal ordinary recipes and two Gaussian recipes with `1024≤H<2^25` and at most 128 bits per supplied profile scalar component. Given the source's original indexed-action and maximum-datum assumptions, explicitly charge at most `2^40` additional actions for carrier and parameter work. The exact resulting serial bound remains below `2^228` transitions. This does not cover native openings, recurring caller/precision costs or a new WASI trace.

The unchanged Gaussian trial is already below `q`, even before finite debit, so the complete target **κ=0.0039 is rejected**. This contribution establishes a conditional ordinary component and a separate setup lemma; it does not assert a complete multiplier, a new κ, physical crossover or selected-frontier change. At the original #8072 κ, retaining the enlarged ordinary profile gives a conditional complete `log₂ C` bound of `682472491`, versus #8072's `318292011` for its different, smaller profile.

## Task and overlap

Scope is **refined** from `supplier-boundary-audit`: this resolves a named ordinary/setup subproblem while leaving full supplier and caller admission open. Package metadata pins the catalogue and selected-record provenance at captured canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The recorded #8072 head is `75f7e1c44f48c43983016bcf8878c4d9e5e87c62`; the inherited #8057 scientific source is pinned at `cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086`. The package retains the specific source files and peer archive needed to reconstruct and replay its controls. The offline replay checks their recorded SHA-256 and Git-blob pins; establishing the #8072 Git-history binding is an optional separate check requiring that commit and its trees locally.

The expanded installer also serves the distinct signed construction in [#8081](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8081). Floration’s [#8080](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8080) changes the capped-profile ordinary opening floor. [#8082](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8082) at `3cb92cf5c07e98a96d298ee33a4d744c5e32f1ca` changes its positive summation reserve.

## Validation

With CPython 3.12.3 and Git 2.56.1, an isolated committed partial-history fixture passed both the metadata check and the complete registered replay:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-ordinary-eta-lift --check-only
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-ordinary-eta-lift
```

The full replay at local fixture commit `e3679ab4906ccbd1bb36f037e7bd72f430c5d33b` took 71.98 seconds and used approximately 1.17 GB peak RSS. It reproduced the exact ordinary receipt, checked four fixed-constructor/directory-census profiles, and rejected altered source files, the adjacent height, the old clamp, the unchanged Gaussian target, the first out-of-range height and an oversized scalar encoding. Each census produced 2,407,819 records. A separate synthetic Git fixture showed the optional source-history checker accepts matching committed bytes and rejects an altered commit. The publication lead then fetched the exact upstream #8072 Git tree into an isolated repository and ran `python3.12 -IB verify.py source-history /path/to/pinned-source`. All ten retained files matched the actual commit byte for byte (exit 0). A fresh extraction of the final archive matched all 25 file hashes and passed the negative controls.

The fixtures do not execute the full astronomical target geometry or establish the five inherited scientific premises. No new physical-product replay, WASI trace or hosted CI result is claimed. The directory hashes are observations, not required cross-environment identities.

## Credit

ToikY supplied #8072 and the #8066–#8071 ordinary, allocation and debit work. Ali Romman supplied #8057 and the #8055 setup argument; SYLforge supplied the #8052 K7 word. The source, archive licenses and notices are retained. This work received substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

See the package README. The smallest next steps are to price a source-bound Gaussian candidate at `q` with owner-return and complete signed costs, bind the enlarged ordinary profile to the full physical/precision path, and separately construct an enlarged-profile portable trace. Each remains blocked by evidence not supplied here.
